subject: Audience playbook + takeaway cards for SaaSWorld showcase
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Audience playbook + takeaway cards for SaaSWorld showcase

Team — quick kickoff for the SaaSWorld booth content pack. Goals: one-sheet playbook for sales, a two‑sided takeaway card for booth drops, and a tight 90s demo script for booth demos and stage micro-sessions.

Ask:
- Marissa: can you draft the 1‑pager (audience, value props per persona, 3x customer bullets) + a short case blurb from ACME (we have acme contact below)?
- Soojin: start a 2-up layout for the takeaway card (front headline + back quick checklist + QR to demo video). Low-fidelity AI or Illustrator file ok.
- Karthik: we’ll need 2 variant headlines (startup vs enterprise) and a suggested booth CTA (demo sign-up flow).

Timeline: first drafts by EOD Monday so we have time to iterate with the events team. I’ve copied the external contact and ACME once we get internal sign-off.

Attachments: none yet — will consolidate first pass in Drive.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audience playbook + takeaway cards for SaaSWorld showcase

Ben — thanks. Drafting the 1‑pager now and pulled a short ACME blurb from last quarter’s case notes. See attached case-blurb-acme.txt (one sentence + 2 metrics).

Notes for the 1‑pager:
- Lead with: "Predictable, low-latency inference at production scale" — keeps it product-forward for platform buyers.
- Personas: Product (dev velocity), Platform (cost/ops), Security (data isolation) — each gets a single line value prop + metric.
- Callouts: Dedicated & Private deployment options + Redwood Optimize (cost tuning).

I attached a quick PDF outline (audience-playbook-v1.pdf) — rough copy, bullets only. I’ll clean language Monday AM and add a customer quote if ACME approves.

Attachments: case-blurb-acme.txt (attachment stub), audience-playbook-v1.pdf (attachment stub)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 13:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audience playbook + takeaway cards for SaaSWorld showcase

Sending a first-pass creative direction: creative-brief.pptx (attachment stub) + a native .ai mock (takeaway-cards-bleed.ai).

Design notes:
- Card front: bold headline + 3-line product snapshot; include small Redwood logo + booth QR.
- Card back: quick checklist "When to choose Redwood" (3 bullets) + tiny flowchart for demo sign-up (scan -> time slot -> immediate demo).
- Color/size constraints: 85mm x 55mm, full-bleed allowance noted in AI file.

Question for Marissa: do we want ACME quote verbatim on the front, or a paraphrased metric callout? Verbatim needs legal approval; paraphrase with metric is faster.

Will iterate on typography tonight and push updated AI by Monday morning.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee | Creative Lead, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: SaaSWorld Events <events@saasworld.com>
Cc: Jenny Park <jenny@acme-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Materials & booth collateral — Redwood @ SaaSWorld (finalizing content pack)

Hi events team — Ben from Redwood here. Looping in our ACME contact, Jenny, because we'll be featuring a short customer blurb on our booth card. Attached is the content pack we plan to bring: audience-playbook-v1.pdf, takeaway-cards-bleed.ai (first mock), 90s-demo-script.docx, and the raw case blurb from ACME.

Requests for you:
1) Confirm we still have the 10:30–11:30 demo window on Day 2 for quick stage micro-sessions (we'll do 4 x 90s spots).
2) Booth drop rule check — are two-sided takeaway cards allowed inside swag bags? If not, we'll provide single-sheet alternatives.
3) Any constraints on QR redirects or video playback at the booth (we'll host a 60s demo clip on a short URL).

Jenny — could you review the ACME blurb (quoted below) and give final approval to use the metric on the front of the card? If you prefer a paraphrase we’ll use that instead.

Quoted ACME blurb: "Using Redwood reduced end-to-end inference cost by 36% and cut median latency from 220ms to 97ms in our production pipeline."

Ben — attaching the files to this message for transparency. We’ll finalize print-ready art once events confirms the booth rules. Thanks everyone —

Ben Carter | Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
